Many years before [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Phobos]] was defeated by a joint force of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].

==Background==
The Jedi and Sith recognized Phobos and her cult as a threat to both factions, so they reluctantly joined forces against the cult in an attempt to stop the [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith]]. The battle ended in a Jedi/Sith victory, with Darth Phobos defeated. Her cult perpetuated for many years, only to become extinct by the time of the [[Fourth Great Schism]] in [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]].

==Legacy==
Despite Phobos' supposed death, rumors of her survival continued for centuries, becoming a legend within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
